note: Runtime parameters of haltere.vision.gap_cue (OFF by default: enabled false). Frozen with its sha256 (content without frozen/frozen_at/sha256, canonical JSON) before any held-out or live score; a change needs a new version and a new freeze, and every version's results are reported. Band, bins, background window, kappa 1.8, mu0 5 deg with the r/kappa margin scaling capped at 2.5, the +-12 deg clip and the 25 deg search window come from the M2 design study (m2design/hybrid/gapcue.py and gapsweep.py on store dev runs; kappa/margin chosen there from 9 settings on Straw Bale / Minus Two dev frames). Unknown (masked or unobserved) columns are neither near nor observed free (the prototype treated them as not free; they then bound an interval without margin). active_deg 2 is the prototype's episode threshold; confirm/release 2 frames, max_age 0.25 s, max_gap 0.3 s, the path corridor and horizon are a-priori values fitted to no data.
mask_source: haltere.obstacles.overlays.overlay_masks on the same 448 x 252 frame; a block is invalid when more than block_mask_max_fraction of its pixels are masked (union of mask_layers). 0.0: any masked pixel invalidates the block. Dev check (store Straw Bale dev runs, synthetic HUD-only disparity: 10 on HUD pixels, 1 elsewhere, block means): 0.3 gave a near column in 2012 of 2058 frames, 0.0 in none; clean-flight episodes 11.32 -> 11.24 /min, pillar-A first confirmed left unchanged except brain03 5.24 -> 4.88 m.
mask_note: Propeller zone not masked: on the design study's Straw Bale dev runs masking it changed clean-flight episodes 11.32 -> 11.24 /min and lowered the share of checkpoint switches with |shift| <= 4 deg in the last 0.5 s from 0.984 to 0.918; hud+ring+ghost vs no mask: 11.32 vs 12.29 /min.
dev_time_logic: Dev sweep (store dev runs only, before any held-out frame; block threshold 0.3 at the time, 0.0 changes the rates by < 0.1 /min): active_deg 2/3/4 x confirm 1/2/3 trades pillar-A lead against Straw Bale clean episodes (e.g. 2/1: 7 of 8 dev approaches confirmed left at >= 5.5 m, 19.0 episodes/min; 2/2: 5 of 8, 11.3/min; 4/3: 2 of 8, 3.1/min); no setting met both the pillar-A and the 6/min clean-flight targets, so the a-priori 2 deg / 2 frames were kept.
